restaurantName: Tian Nan Xing Minced Pork Noodle
address: Kaki Bukit 511 Market & Food Centre, #01-10, 511 Bedok North Street 3, 460511, Singapore
bio: This century-old brand is now run by the third and fourth generations of the family. Bouncy noodles, pork dumplings and pork meatballs come in a rich, tasty broth made with pork bones, garlic and a generous amount of minced pork.
pageTitle: Tian Nan Xing Minced Pork Noodle
